title: A Heart of Flesh
question: What is God promising to replace, and with what?
blurb: Not a better effort but a new heart. See where else Scripture promises the same exchange.

nodes.content: What is God promising to replace, and with what?

nodes.verseText: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will remove your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
And I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My statutes and to carefully observe My ordinances.

“But this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the LORD. I will put My law in their minds and inscribe it on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people.
Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
It is clear that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.
